notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.5 - Now Ongoing
notes.notes:
Commanders,



A huge thank you to everyone who has jumped into the playtest. Your participation and feedback have been incredibly valuable.

After meeting so many of you and hearing your thoughts at events like BitSummit and ChinaJoy, we realized that closing access to the playtest would feel like cutting a great conversation short. So we've decided that:


The playtest is now ongoing, with no scheduled end date!


To support this extended mission, we'll be rolling out regular updates. Today's patch (v0.13.5) introduces a new officer for Exploration Mode, along with some new narrative content to uncover:



New Officer MAKAILA: Once destined to be the light of her civilization, a tragic accident caused her to cast it into shadow. She can inspire allies with a warm glow or unleash scorching flame upon her enemies.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/3d8bd3c6b0c2bd1b9745bd728c03fcdf6ff7735f.png"]



New Story Content: Discover more of the world through the reworked exploration mission.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/1a933a17bf3352cadafa124eeaeef8e94daf56c2.png"]



General Improvements: A batch of quality-of-life optimizations and experimental sound effects have been added to improve the overall experience.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/ed7cad784d52fc3538fe1085499fbdd5562ab8c5.png"]


[hr][/hr]Patch Notes

Content
New Officer: MAKAILA is now available as a starting officer in Exploration Mode.

New Narrative: Added new exploration plotlines and branching events with unique dialogues for each Officer.

Gameplay Change: To ensure tactical integrity, character modification (leveling up, equipping echoes, resetting levels) is now restricted in the combat phase.


UI / UX
Camera: You can now pan the camera by moving your cursor to the edge of the screen. A boundary has been added to prevent the camera from moving too far into unexplored darkness.

Ability Clarity:

Available Duality Swap abilities will now have a glow.

Abilities on cooldown are now covered with a grey mask.

Zone object buttons now have a pulse indicator for better visibility.

Status Indicators: Operatives with remaining movement or attack actions are now highlighted on their health plate.

Combat Flow:

Added a "Skip Confirmation" option for ending your turn, for faster play.

Damage prediction is now more accurate, accounting for more triggered effects like damage redirection.

The "Retreat" button is now correctly disabled during the enemy's turn.

General: Added an option to lock the mouse to the game window (hold ALT to temporarily unlock).


Visuals
Animations: Officers now play deployment animation when entering the battlefield.

UI: Iterated the panel for Duality Swap abilities and improved the tooltip layout for tile effects.

Effects: Updated the outline effect on units and objects to be crisper and more defined.

Environment: Decorations will now become semi-transparent when a unit is standing on their tile or when hovered over, improving battlefield clarity.


Audio
Experimental SFX: Added the first implementation of sound effects for various gameplay actions and UI interactions. This feature can be enabled in the settings menu.


Performance
Optimized performance to improve average FPS across most scenes.

Reduced the frequency of frame spikes during gameplay.


Fixes
Fixed a bug where dialogue could get stuck if the player held CTRL to speed it up.

Fixed a bug causing dialogue text animations to be delayed at incorrect positions.

Fixed a bug where the Protection Totem could incorrectly grant damage immunity to units not adjacent to it.

Fixed a bug where tile trigger effects were not being saved correctly.

Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting to the main menu under certain conditions.

Fixed a bug where damage from the "Surround Consume" mechanic was being incorrectly reduced by Defense.


Other
Updated the credits roll.

Updated some area and unit names to align with the latest story developments.


[hr][/hr]Share your thoughts


Your feedback is the compass that guides our development. Please continue to share your thoughts!

Press F2 in-game to report a bug or share a suggestion

Fill out the survey after completing each mode (it's also available from the main menu)

Join our Discord to chat directly with the dev team


[hr][/hr]
If you're enjoying this journey, please consider adding Paraside: Duality Unbound to your Steam Wishlist. For a small team like ours, that single click makes a huge difference.

Thank you for being with us.



— Paraside Dev Team

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.4
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders,



Build v0.13.4 is now live! Thank you to everyone who's been testing and sending feedback. This update focuses on common issues, bug fixes, and a few quality-of-life tweaks. Refresh Steam to grab the patch and let us know how it feels ːhappy_seagullː


Patch Notes

Content
Connected the Other Side of the south-west Polarity Post to the Capital.


UI / UX
Added a level-up icon to operative buttons in the side panel and the Operatives window.

Added a warning pop-up when a controller is detected (as full controller support isn't ready yet).

Added a warning when you don't have enough Reset Tokens.

Added a glow to the Survey button.

Added access to End Turn and End Battle even while an operative is selected.

Added a dedicated Deselect button.

Clicking the currently selected operative now jumps to manual Attack instead of spending a Move.

Changed friendly threat zone color to yellow.

Changed the Exchange Rune draw animation to be much faster.

Changed the black screen animation in several places for a more natural feel.


Audio
Added a "whoosh" SFX when entering any mode.

Replaced exploration music with a calmer, more ambient track.

 
Fixes
Corrected several typos and unified attribute keywords across the game.

Fixed a crash that could occur after opening Guardian's school-selection panel and then viewing other operatives.

Fixed a crash caused by additive effects during an Attack after a Turn Reset.

Fixed officers losing experience after loading a save.

Fixed damage numbers appearing in the wrong screen position at non-1080p resolutions.

Fixed Recon Swap occasionally failing to set scene lighting.


What’s Next


The new officer MAKAILA is almost ready, and we're expanding the exploration story in the next update. If there's something you'd like us to prioritize, drop a note in the comments or on Discord.



Thanks for participating in the playtest. Cheers!

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.3
notes.notes:
Hey Commanders,

A new build is live! Refresh Steam to grab v0.13.3 and let us know if it smooths things out.

Patch Notes

Balance

Golden-Eyes Druid now casts fewer tile effects, making the fights a bit less RNG-heavy.

Fixes

Crash when using the keyboard shortcut to undeploy an Officer.
Conquered places popping back during a Realm Swap.
Save-load issue that could corrupt campaign progress in Exploration mode.

What’s Next

We'll send a proper announcement about the playtest soon. Your feedback over the last few days has been invaluable, keep it coming on Discord or through the in-game survey. 

Thanks for participating in the playtest. Cheers!
